def: An open-source Python and JavaScript framework, launched in October 2022, with standard interfaces and integrations for models, tools and retrievers; since 1.0 (October 2025) its agents run on LangGraph.
practice: The most common name in tutorials; much older code uses chains and other legacy APIs that moved to the langchain-classic package in 1.0, so check which era a codebase comes from before upgrading.
